name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A privacy-first, local-first knowledge base that combines notes, documents, and whiteboards in one app, as a self-hosted alternative to Notion and Miro.
buyer: A privacy-minded professional or small firm, such as a law office or healthcare practice, that cannot put internal notes and plans into a third-party cloud tool.
business_use_cases: A managed-IT provider offers self-hosted AFFiNE deployments as a privacy-compliant Notion alternative for regulated small businesses.
A consultant customizes and themes it as a white-labeled internal wiki for a client company.
An agency builds client onboarding and migration services moving teams off Notion onto a self-hosted instance.

money_ideas.idea: Managed self-hosting and maintenance billed monthly per client

steal_this: Offer one privacy-conscious local business a free self-hosted setup this week, then bill monthly for upkeep.
